name: Kahn
summary: The company secretary, identified by Larry at right in VN-0003. Larry remembers that he "walked funny, stiff legged like he had polio."
researchNotes: As company secretary he would appear throughout the unit's paperwork, making him a good anchor name for locating the unit's morning reports at NPRC once the unit itself is confirmed. The spelling is phonetic; Kahn, Khan, Conn, and Kohn are all candidates. 2026-08-23 (giscus-stories-c18118728): "Khan wrote the morning reports for the Unit." This makes Kahn directly relevant to the morning-reports request (issue #27): if those reports are obtained, his name should appear on them as the clerk who typed them, which would both corroborate this account and confirm the unit.
